candidate.prompt:
Create ONE native original hand-painted realistic game prop: a SMALL EMPTY SALVAGED CAGE from the lower quarters of a Yautja alien Homeworld. Requested1024×1024 PNG with TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. One complete independent object, not a scene, sprite sheet, atlas or set of variants.

LOCKED ART FAMILY: charcoal porous volcanic basalt, worn angular patinated bronze, dark metal with realistic fine scratches, one tiny dull amber latch slit. Same sober dark sci-fi hunting-clan material language as the existing native Homeworld props. Orthographic elevated three-quarter camera approximately32degrees, front and right side visible with the roof seen. Upper-left light. Controlled contrast and realistic thick material edges; do not use cartoon outlines.

DISTINCT LOWER-QUARTER CONSTRUCTION: an improvised compact asymmetric TRAPEZOIDAL cage-trap made from salvaged Yautja panels and reclaimed bronze bars. It has one low long basalt base, a high blunt rear corner frame and a visibly lower sloping front edge so the whole silhouette slopes downward, unlike a hexagonal fauna cage or rectangular heavy crate. The two side faces use unevenly spaced upright salvaged bars fastened into different angular repaired brackets. Three mismatched riveted repair plates reinforce one back corner; one diagonal exterior bronze brace gives visible practical repair character. The roof remains mostly open barred structure, with one small bent patch plate only over the back quarter. A closed small sliding barred hatch at the near end has a simple repaired locking hasp. Physical supports are two short irregular basalt feet integrated into the base, not loose rocks. Show wear, soot, small dings and patch joints; keep the object mechanically readable rather than a pile of junk. It is an intentionally serviceable modest cage in a poor salvage district, with a unique sloped repaired silhouette. Do not merely recolor a clean fauna cage.

Interior ENTIRELY EMPTY, no creature, animal, person, silhouette, egg, body, bones, food, weapons, skull, trophies, symbols, letters, writing, labels or numbers. No extra cage, detached items, hanging chains, environment, floor tile, dust or smoke. Not a human bird cage, pet carrier, kennel, stable, medieval prison, building, rust-red steel container or opaque shipping box. Large clear gaps between the bars must be transparent except where actual far bars or the physical floor are behind them.

FRAMING IS CRITICAL: use a small render within the square with EXTRA generous empty transparent border, ideally128pixels empty space on ALL FOUR SIDES of the requested1024canvas. Keep the whole cage including every foot, rear frame, patch, brace and latch completely inside the CENTRAL THREE-FIFTHS of the canvas. The maximum object width should be about720pixels on a1024canvas; do not enlarge it to fill the frame. Leave breathing room visibly around all sides. Full object visible without cropping, true transparent background and bar openings, no opaque black matte, no checkerboard painted into image, no cast floor shadow, no hazy halo. One object only.

admissionCriteriaCatalogue.requirement: Original independent native PNG/atlas cell, silhouette whole, positive uniform scale, explicit native rectangle/dimensions/pivot, actual alpha and occupied bounds including all margins and edge pixels; do not manufacture missing function by extracting a painted detail. Preserve original bytes and SHA256/provenance.

Keep exact target ID, role/function, provenance category and candidate status. Existing presence, decode, tests or an assistant inspection never grant human artistic validated status. This audit closes no catalogue entry.

Prop isolation screenshot with a real reference Yautja; inspect silhouette, scale, pivot, alpha, orientation and physical ground support. World dimensions are separate from bitmap dimensions and collision footprint.

Inspect in actual district with wide/medium/near screenshots; verify free approach, usage and exit space, depth and ground support. Common props need visual diversity ideally4–8 native variants. A candidate image does not prove integration/gameplay completion.

Verify plot support, facade orientation, reachable entrance, true passage/cabin clearance and both travel directions. Existing lift V82 must be reviewed rather than regenerated merely because of historical MISSING. No route or collision claim arises from an image.
Author left/right views independently where requested; do not rotate, mirror, skew or stretch a PNG to claim a missing native orientation.

An active/energy state needs distinct native painted temporal states with frame rects,pivots,durations,loop contract and actual rendered temporal inspection. A static support, CSS opacity/transform pulse, NPC walking sheet or recolor does not establish an authored native work/energy cycle. Keep pause/reduced-motion/loading failure behavior explicit.

Show the requested animal-care function and accessible working edge at fauna/mount scale. Habitat support is a rock shelf, not cage/enclosure. A stable-harness NPC, beast picture or static mount does not deliver an independent harness/saddle/cage or mount gameplay. Avoid a human stable; mark local invented iconography original.
